commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED='067fa6f744f5e28233eb5b267edd7d6daa262c2c'
git fetch origin --prune
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903)" = "$EXPECTED"
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent-control-tmp-ignore origin/main
INSPECT1="$(git rev-parse origin/agent-control-inspect)"
INSPECT2="$(git rev-parse origin/agent-control-inspect-2)"
test "$INSPECT1" = "$INSPECT2"
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent-control-inspect origin/agent-control
for b in 'integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903' 'agent-control-tmp-ignore' 'agent-control-inspect' 'agent-control-inspect-2'; do git push origin --delete "$b"; done
git fetch origin --prune
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/agent-control
for b in 'integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903' 'agent-control-tmp-ignore' 'agent-control-inspect' 'agent-control-inspect-2'; do if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$b"; then echo "branch still exists: $b" >&2; exit 30; fi; done
echo BRANCH_CLEANUP=PASS
echo MAIN_HEAD="$EXPECTED"
echo REMAINING_EXPECTED='main agent-control'
